summary: Master the art of negotiation with our specialized training course. Gain essential skills to navigate business discussions and secure better deals.
lede: Business negotiation training prepares professionals who manage contracts, resources or teams to plan discussions and pursue workable agreements. Learners practise setting BATNA, WATNA and ZOPA, mapping stakeholder interests, and using objective criteria and concession sequencing to handle negotiation choices. The syllabus also covers active listening, persuasive framing, term-sheet drafting and post-agreement review, with exercises including vendor-contract and virtual-negotiation simulations.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who are responsible for securing resources, managing contracts, or leading teams through complex change initiatives.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of professional experience in a role involving contract management, sales, procurement, or project leadership. No prior formal negotiation training is required, though a basic understanding of commercial contract structures is beneficial. Participants are encouraged to bring a non-confidential negotiation scenario from their current work for use in the practical workshops.
